title: Wings live: Riverfront Coliseum, Cincinnati | 1976
content:
Wings performed at the Riverfront Coliseum in Cincinnati, Ohio, USA, on 27 May 1976.

It was the 44th night of the 65-date Wings Over The World Tour, which ran from September 1975 to October 1976.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, bass guitar, and keyboards; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Jimmy McCulloch on guitar and vocals; and Joe English on drums, plus a horns and brass section consisting of Howie Casey, Tony Dorsey, Steve Howard, and Thaddeus Richard.

The performances of ‘Venus And Mars’, ‘Rock Show’, ‘Jet’, ‘Let Me Roll It’, ‘Medicine Jar’, ‘Call Me Back Again’, and ‘Bluebird’ from this night appear on the 1976 live album Wings Over America.

Paul McCartney returned to the Riverfront Coliseum on 12 February 1990, 5 May 1993, and 10 July 2016.
